Text: Welcome to the Blue Point Art archiveand to Living Heritage
remediating through video poetry.
You are now entering the archival versionof an exhibition presented from
19 to 20 7th November 2025,both at the Gallery of the Faculty of Fine
Arts of the University of Lisbon,and in spatial.
In this galleryyou will encounter three video
poems, each lasting around five minutes.
The works are based on textsby Stanislaw Młodożeniec,
Stanislaw Vincenzand Fernando Pessoa with his heteronyms.
Each video poem is accompanied by a shortdescription.
You can also open the sidebar to findfurther information about the exhibition.
Read the curatorial text and download
a PDF version of the exhibition materials.
A working Englishtranslation of the text used in One
Earth is also available there, along
with further information about the authorswhose works are reimagined in the video.
Poems.
This exhibition invites you into a journeythrough literary heritage,
reimagined through image,sound, rhythm and voice.
Here, the video poem becomes a mediumthrough which poetry can be revisited,
reinterpreted and experienced in new ways.
You are welcome to move through the spaceat your own pace, and begin
with any of the works around you.
Thank you for visiting and we hope you enjoy your journey through living heritage.
